thesis: The site is a cutaway of one shower wall: every section is one layer of the build, shown in order from stud to tile, and the finished surface appears only at the end as the reward for doing the hidden work right.

signature.name: layer-stack ruler
signature.summary: A vertical bar on the left margin divided into five colored bands (stud, backer, membrane-orange, thinset-gray, tile-white) that fills as you scroll, with thickness readings in fractions of an inch. The same five colors appear as section dividers, process timeline states, and estimator sheet progress.

motion.intro: Five layer bands slide in from left edge staggered 60ms, total ≤1s; headline line-mask reveals after.
stories: Shower wall cutaway pinned on desktop ≥640px; each layer draws on in sequence, water line drops at membrane step. Height calc(5*55svh+100svh). Reduced motion: five stacked labeled drawings.
Estimator SVG sketch builds room-by-room via clip-path reveal as choices are made.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX, 200ms, @media (hover:hover) only.
